title: Derived identifications for a specified tensor chain map
statement: Let $g':X'\to X$ be a scheme morphism, let $E,K$ be objects of $D(\mathcal O_X)$ and $K'$ an object of $D(\mathcal O_{X'})$, with a morphism $\phi:Lg'^*K\to K'$ and K-flat coordinates $c$ for it [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Let $P$ be K-flat with $e_P:QP\cong E$. Let $\tau(A,B):Lg'^*(A\otimes B)\to Lg'^*A\otimes Lg'^*B$ be natural. Let $H$ denote termwise module pullback. Suppose $\chi:H\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes c.P)\cong\operatorname{Tot}(HP\otimes H(c.P))$ satisfies the canonical derived counit equation of [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison] for this pair. Set $T=\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes c.P)$, $N=\operatorname{Tot}(HP\otimes c.N)$, and $d=\chi;(1\otimes c.t)$. There are isomorphisms $e:QT\cong E\otimes K$ and $e':QN\cong Lg'^*E\otimes K'$ such that $T$ is K-flat, its shared pullback counit is invertible, and $\epsilon_T;Qd;e'=Lg'^*e;\tau(E,K);(1\otimes\phi)$. No stalk assertion or cartesian square is involved.

proof.text: The source is K-flat by the K-flat tensor theorem; pullback preserves K-flatness of P. The localization tensor maps on P,c.P and HP,c.N are invertible by the upstream derived monoidal localization on K-flat inputs. Set e to the inverse source localization map followed by eP tensor c.e, and e prime to the inverse target localization map followed by the tensor of the inverse shared counit on P and derivedPullback(eP) with c.e prime. The shared counit is invertible on K-flat complexes by uniqueness of left-derived functors and the recorded K-flat counit.

Precompose the representation equation with derivedPullback of the invertible source localization tensor map. Substitute the supplied counit equation, use localization tensor-map naturality for identity tensor c.t, and cancel the target localization map. Tensor composition cancels the counit on P; c.represents identifies the second-factor composite. Naturality of tau at eP and c.e gives the desired right side. This is exactly tensor_representation_algebra in Lean.

theorem exists_tensor_coordinate_identifications
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (E K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (τ : ∀ A B : schemeDerivedCategory X,
      (derivedPullback g').obj (A ⊗ B) ⟶
        (derivedPullback g').obj A ⊗ (derivedPullback g').obj B)
    (hnat : ∀ (A A' B B' : schemeDerivedCategory X) (a : A ⟶ A') (b : B ⟶ B'),
      (derivedPullback g').map (a ⊗ₘ b) ≫ τ A' B' =
        τ A B ≫ ((derivedPullback g').map a ⊗ₘ (derivedPullback g').map b))
    (c : SingleComplexBaseChange.Coordinates g' K K' φ)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (eP : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ E) (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat)
    (χ : ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (pullbackTensorTotal X P c.P) ≅
      pullbackTensorTotal X'
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj c.P))
    (hχ : (derivedPullback g').map (pullbackTensorModelMap X P c.P) ≫
        (SingleComplexBaseChange.counit g').app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj (pullbackTensorTotal X P c.P)) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map χ.hom =
      τ (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj c.P) ≫
        ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit g').app
            ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P) ⊗ₘ
          (SingleComplexBaseChange.counit g').app
            ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj c.P)) ≫
        pullbackTensorModelMap X'
          (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
          (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj c.P)) :
    let T := pullbackTensorTotal X P c.P
    let N := pullbackTensorTotal X'
      (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) c.N
    let d := χ.hom ≫
      HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap (𝟙 _) c.t (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ)
    ∃ (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj T ≅ E ⊗ K)
      (e' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj N ≅ (derivedPullback g').obj E ⊗ K'),
      T.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat ∧
      IsIso ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit g').app
        ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj T)) ∧
      (SingleComplexBaseChange.counit g').app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj T) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Q.map d ≫ e'.hom =
      (derivedPullback g').map e.hom ≫ (τ E K ≫ ((derivedPullback g').obj E ◁ φ))
